items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I just remember Fats Waller from that area. I did a tune by him... I played it at the high school auditorium

ctx.x: Yeah. Well, I don’t know whether he knew about Scott Joplin. But Fats Waller, I remember...
That’s right. He did like Fats Waller.
Well, he certainly wasn’t alone in that. I gather, again from reading the interviews, that you showed an aptitude for the piano very young.
